title: PostNewton
author: JG
description: PostNewton missing in explicit solvers; add warning or add after single steps (but exclude in contact computation!)
releaseNotes: explicit solvers (RK, DOPRI5, ...) warn at the start of a solve about objects that update their state in the PostNewton step of the implicit solvers - contact, friction, switching, rotation counters, sliding joints - which the explicit solvers do not update
